title: Storytime / Hora de Cuentos
description: 10:30 AM – 11:30 AM · English stories, songs, rhymes and fun for children of all ages and their parents or caregivers. Cuentos, canciones, rimas y diversión en inglés para niños de todas las edades y sus padres o cuidadores.

title: Pup Meetup at the Gondola Plaza
description: 11:30 AM – 12:00 PM · Get ready to unleash the fun at our Pup Meetup! 🐶 Join us at the Gondola Plaza by the Coffee Cowboy Cart for a tail-wagging good time that's sure to leave both you and your furry friend feeling pawsitively delighted. Make sure to stick around for the raffle with prizes from local pet stores and free pup cups from the Coffee Cowboy! Marney Prince with My Pup's Remedy will be there with free treats for your furry friend as well! With the Wilkinson Public Library, anything is PAW-sible. Who knows...you may even make some new FUR-ever friends!

title: Cocina con Corazón
description: 12:00 PM – 1:30 PM · Tendremos el programa Cocina con Corazón cada mes asociado con Ah Haa para traer más programas para la comunidad de hispanohablantes. Vamos a cocinar pupusas con Krista.  Este program solamente es para adultos y en español.   ¡Tenemos espacio para 12 adultos, inscríbete con Claudia hoy!  Todos los niveles de español son bienvenidos.

title: Teen Cook
description: 2:00 PM – 3:00 PM · Join us every Tuesday this summer for Teen Cook, where we prepare a variety of delicious foods and get to try out something new.

title: I Heart Art with SMRC
description: A Library-hosted arts program presented in partnership with SMRC, taking place on the Lower Terrace outdoors. The event runs for one hour in the afternoon.

title: Punk Science with Pinhead
description: A library event at Wilkinson Public Library featuring Punk Science with Pinhead, held outdoors on the Lower Terrace. The program runs from 5:15 to 6:00 PM.

title: Bardic Trails Online Poetry Night: Lawton Eddy
description: 7:00 PM – 8:30 PM · The Telluride Institute's Bardic Trails poetry night features an award-winning guest poet sharing their new and exciting work. The reading will be followed with a Q & A about the poet's work and inspirations, with time afterwards for poetry sharing from attendees – a Gourd Circle of sharing whatever poetry attendees wish, or just listening in. The list of 2026 poets is below. The free Bardic Trails virtual Zoom series is on the first Tuesday of each month.
